resources.string: Kelo reads every connected calendar and mailbox for the briefing and heads-ups. Switch one off to leave it out.
You can also just tell Kelo in the chat, for example “leave my work mail out of the briefing”.
Use the CalDAV address your provider gives (for example https://dav.fastmail.com/ for Fastmail), your user name and an app password.
Kelo only reads this calendar, for the briefing and heads-ups. It never changes it.
Disconnect %1$s? The saved app password will be erased.
I connected my calendar. Please continue.
